contentHtml:
TREATMENT

Botox & Dermal Fillers in Ghaziabad

Subtle, natural-looking rejuvenation by a board-certified dermatologist.

Overview

Refresh tired-looking skin with USFDA-approved Botox, HIFU, Juvederm Fillers, Botox, Thread Lift, Rf skin tightening Age reverse facial, Microneedling with PRP, hyaluronic acid skin boosters, PDRN skin boostes, PROFHILO hyaluronic-acid fillers performed by Dr. Aarushi Tyagi.

We focus on natural, expression-preserving results — never frozen, never overdone.

Key benefits

  • Smooths forehead lines, frown lines & crow’s feet
  • Defines jawline, cheeks & lips
  • Lasts 6–12 months
  • 10–20 minute lunch-break procedure
  • Immediate results with zero downtime

Who should opt

  • Adults 25+ noticing fine lines or volume loss
  • Those preparing for weddings or special events
  • Anyone seeking preventative anti-aging

The Procedure

01

Aesthetic consultation & facial mapping

02

Topical numbing for comfort

03

Precision micro-injections

04

Cold compress & aftercare instructions

05

Two-week review to fine-tune results

BEFORE & AFTER

Real results from real patients

View documented transformations from our Botox & fillers patients.

VIEW GALLERY →

Frequently Asked Questions

Will I look unnatural?

No. Our philosophy focuses on subtle enhancement and natural facial balance. Results are expression-preserving and never overdone.

How long do results last?

Botox generally lasts 4–6 months, while fillers may last between 6–12 months depending on area and product used.

Are the products safe?

Yes. We only use USFDA-approved injectables sourced through certified medical distributors.
